supported_surfaces.coverage: Lean model for accepted proof metadata binding, TEE/recursive/zkVM field discipline, and digest uniqueness under an explicit injectivity assumption.

Risc0 spot-transition proof envelope to ZenoLedger proof metadata, including header binding, optional verifier-command acceptance, optional proof app-hash to header state-root checks, and metadata binding for ingress, nonce, and accepted-receipt roots.
Rust shared transition and Python spot fixtures agree for CPMM pool-id hashing, create-pool, faucet mint, swap-exact-in, add-liquidity, and remove-liquidity fixture semantics.

Opt-in real Risc0 proof smoke for empty transition plus faucet mint, create-pool, swap-exact-in, add-liquidity, remove-liquidity, and one multi-transaction spot liquidity-cycle block over the supported spot v1 operation families, with guest nonce sequencing, accepted-receipt roots, and emitted ZenoLedger body/header/proof-metadata bindings checked by the archive checker.

ZenoLedger range verifier requires proof metadata plus verifier-backed proof-verification reports per checked height when the active profile or bridge policy requires proof journals; Risc0 reports must be body-checked and bind post_app_hash to the header app hash or post-state root.

ZenoLedger range verifier can require per-height proof-verification reports that match header-bound proof metadata and Risc0 semantic binding checks; explicit signed-report mode requires a proof-report signer registry and per-height envelope bundle, then verifies BLS quorum over the canonical report artifact hash and emits per-height quorum report hashes.
Local light-client checkpoint verifier binds verified header/body/checkpoint replay to a signer-registry signature-set root and BLS checkpoint quorum.

Recursive spot, zUSD deposit-mint, and perps NP leaf summaries derive lifecycle asset-delta rows from checked transition inputs or journals, bind those rows through asset_delta_root, require CLI metadata rows to recompute to the journal root, and expose a Tau-compatible recursive lifecycle admission gate over host-projected proof, row, aggregate, authority, header, and transcript booleans.

Deterministic recursive lifecycle admission packet checker recomputes the aggregate asset-delta row root, checks aggregate row conservation, authority roots, proof profile, proof verification flag, header root binding, transcript binding, and emits the Tau-compatible admission booleans. This is a local fail-closed admission checker and does not claim production recursive runtime integration, data availability, source finality, or recursive proof cryptographic soundness.

gap_surfaces.gap: The current real RISC0 proof smoke covers the listed spot v1 operation subset only. Complete spot block proof coverage still lacks swap-exact-out, multi-hop, native asset sync, rejected-receipt execution, and exhaustive block-operation semantics.
No real zkVM proof currently covers UPBA v2/v3 batch clearing, exact-out, or candidate-grid optimality.
No real zkVM proof currently covers ZenoOracle critical-action packets or oracle truth/governance assumptions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers zUSD mint, liquidation, recovery, or supply-conservation lifecycle transitions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers perps settlement, liquidation, ADL, funding, or insurance transitions.
No real zkVM proof currently covers proof-mining manager rewards, claimability, or reward payout bridge execution.

Local checkpoint quorum replay now binds one verified chain segment to a signer registry and BLS quorum, but production validator rotation, fork-choice, slashing, peer discovery, and adversarial network finality remain out of scope.

Local recursive leaf/root plumbing and lifecycle row roots exist, but production recursive epoch coverage still lacks release-manifest evidence for real root receipts, runtime header admission binding, data availability policy, and source-finality certificates.

No recursive RISC0 oracle leaf currently derives an oracle critical-action or aggregate report summary, and no recursive proof claim covers oracle truth, reporter honesty, feed governance, or live source availability.

The recursive lifecycle Tau gate is available as a host-projected admission contract, but production runtime admission still needs release evidence that root proof verification, header root binding, transcript binding, authority roots, and DA/source-finality certificates are enforced together.

The recursive zUSD leaf exposes the current DepositMint row, but repay, redeem, burn, liquidation, stability-pool movement, and native collateral movement still need exhaustive row extractors before sharing a full recursive asset-conservation claim.
